name: How much does it cost to generate a Knowledge Graph and Entity File for a mid-sized company?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to generate a Knowledge Graph and Entity File for a mid-sized company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary significantly based on data volume, complexity, and whether you use automated LLM-driven tools or custom engineering; small projects may cost a few thousand dollars while enterprise-grade graphs can exceed $50,000 depending on customization and ongoing maintenance needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from a few thousand dollars for small projects to over $50,000 for enterprise-grade graphs, depending on data volume, complexity, and customization.
